replacements.instruction: Remove the navigation-only sentence explaining why the seven pre-specified systems are numbered, while preserving the seven-system study definition by folding it into the Alternative writing systems topic sentence.
replacements.before:
We consider seven pre-specified systems under the same generation setup.
The systems are numbered below so that the alternatives, ablations, execution variant, and full system can be distinguished throughout the analysis.

\paragraph{Alternative writing systems.}
We compare three alternatives to \condAgenticCogWriter: (1) \condSinglePass\ produces the complete document in one generation call; (2) \condStaged\ executes \texttt{Pre-Write}$\rightarrow$\texttt{Write}$\rightarrow$\texttt{Re-Write}, following the common separation of planning, drafting, and revision~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; and (3) \condTaskPlanning\ follows a WriteHERE-style adaptive task graph~\citep{xiong2025beyond}, recursively decomposing the assignment and selecting among dependency-satisfied task nodes.
replacements.after:
\paragraph{Alternative writing systems.}
Among the seven pre-specified systems under the same generation setup, we compare three alternatives to \condAgenticCogWriter: (1) \condSinglePass\ produces the complete document in one generation call; (2) \condStaged\ executes \texttt{Pre-Write}$\rightarrow$\texttt{Write}$\rightarrow$\texttt{Re-Write}, following the common separation of planning, drafting, and revision~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; and (3) \condTaskPlanning\ follows a WriteHERE-style adaptive task graph~\citep{xiong2025beyond}, recursively decomposing the assignment and selecting among dependency-satisfied task nodes.

replacements.instruction: Delete the benchmark-summary sentence that merely restates the three benchmark descriptions, and join the demanding-subset rationale to the same paragraph so the manuscript does not create a one-sentence body paragraph.
replacements.before:
We use three benchmarks to test whether process-level organization transfers across different forms of long-form writing: (1) WritingBench~\citep{wu2026writingbench}, which covers broad real-world writing requests with task-specific evaluation criteria; (2) HelloBench~\citep{que2024hellobench}, which includes long-text summarization, open-ended generation, and completion; and (3) DoLoMiTes~\citep{malaviya2025dolomites}, which targets methodical expert writing with explicit objectives, procedures, inputs, and constraints.
The benchmarks cover general instruction following, sustained long-context generation, and structured expert-document production.

We evaluate fixed demanding subsets because short or lightly constrained tasks may not reveal differences in how a system manages a long document.
replacements.after:
We use three benchmarks to test whether process-level organization transfers across different forms of long-form writing: (1) WritingBench~\citep{wu2026writingbench}, which covers broad real-world writing requests with task-specific evaluation criteria; (2) HelloBench~\citep{que2024hellobench}, which includes long-text summarization, open-ended generation, and completion; and (3) DoLoMiTes~\citep{malaviya2025dolomites}, which targets methodical expert writing with explicit objectives, procedures, inputs, and constraints.
We evaluate fixed demanding subsets because short or lightly constrained tasks may not reveal differences in how a system manages a long document.
